'''Lina Naras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of an Imperial [[Trivar II Imperial Detention Center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]]. She carried a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
